questions.q: Two trains move in opposite directions at 60 km/h and 90 km/h. Their lengths are 1.10 km and 0.9 km. How many seconds does the slower train take to cross the faster?
questions.why: 2000 m at 150 km/h (125/3 m/s) = 48 s. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word PEPPER be arranged?
questions.why: 6 letters with repeats: 6! ÷ 3! ÷ 2! = 60. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 10 April 2025 was a Thursday, what day of the week was 20 June 2025?
questions.why: 71 days later; 71 mod 7 = 1, so count 1 day on from Thursday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Sara lives in a large East Coast city. Her younger cousin Marlee lives in a small Mid-west town. Marlee has visited Sara several times in five years; Sara has visited Marlee once. Which must be true?
questions.why: Marlee is the younger cousin, so Sara is older. The rest is speculation. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: Sita walks 5 m East, then turns left and walks 8 m, then turns left and walks 9 m. Which direction is Sita facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the West. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The present ages of Kiran and Asha are in the ratio 2 : 5. After 10 years the ratio will be 16 : 25. What is Asha's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 2k and 5k: (2k + 10)/(5k + 10) = 16/25 gives k = 3, so Asha is 15. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: No rivers are lakes. All lakes are ponds. Conclusions: I. Some ponds are rivers. II. Some ponds are not rivers.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Ravi walks 2 m North, then turns right and walks 5 m, then turns right and walks 2 m. Which direction is Ravi facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the South. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The present ages of Vijay and Ajay are in the ratio 2 : 3. After 6 years the ratio will be 3 : 4. What is Ajay's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 2k and 3k: (2k + 6)/(3k + 6) = 3/4 gives k = 6, so Ajay is 18. GPSC-style practice item.
